en.title: Taiwan military tracks 7 Chinese vessels, 5 official vessels and 22 aircraft sorties around Taiwan
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said it detected 7 Chinese vessels, 5 official vessels and 22 Chinese aircraft sorties around Taiwan from 6 a.m. on November 3 to 6 a.m. on November 4, with 14 sorties entering the southwestern and eastern airspace, and that the military monitored the activity and responded.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense said that from 6 a.m. on November 3 to 6 a.m. on November 4, it detected 7 Chinese vessels, 5 official vessels and 22 Chinese aircraft sorties in the areas around Taiwan, with 14 of the aircraft sorties entering the southwestern and eastern airspace.

The ministry said Taiwan's military monitored the activity and responded with task aircraft and vessels as well as land-based missile systems, keeping a close watch on the situation around the Taiwan Strait.

facts.claim: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported that from 6 a.m. on November 3 to 6 a.m. on November 4, it detected 7 Chinese vessels, 5 official vessels and 22 Chinese aircraft sorties around Taiwan, with 14 sorties entering the southwestern and eastern airspace.
Taiwan's military monitored the activity and responded using task aircraft and vessels and land-based missile systems.

zh.title: 國防部偵獲共艦7艘、公務船5艘及共機22架次，國軍嚴密監控應處
zh.summary: 國防部表示，自11月3日上午6時至11月4日上午6時止，偵獲共艦7艘、公務船5艘及共機22架次，其中14架次進入西南及東部空域，國軍嚴密監控並以任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統應處。
body: 國防部表示，自11月3日上午6時至11月4日上午6時止，偵獲共艦7艘、公務船5艘及共機22架次，其中14架次進入西南及東部空域，相關動態均在臺海周邊出現。
國防部指出，國軍運用任務機、艦及岸置飛彈系統嚴密監控並適切應處，持續掌握臺海周邊動態。
